question: How should the practitioner inscribe the kāmakūṭa in relation to the body’s joints?
premises: The kāmakūṭa is to be drawn.
It is characterized as merged in all limb joints.
The act is prescribed as a ritual inscription.
inference: The practitioner must visualize or inscribe the kāmakūṭa as permeating every joint of the body.
uncertainties: Whether samālikhet implies physical drawing or mental visualization is not explicit.
plain_english: One should draw the kāmakūṭa as merged into all the joints of the body.
